ideas.name: MES leads, MNQ lags
ideas.why: broad-market flow and index arbitrage hit the S&P first; when MES has moved and MNQ has not, MNQ catches up

ideas.name: MNQ new high without MES
ideas.why: a new session high in NQ that the S&P does not confirm is narrow buying, which fades

ideas.name: NQ outperforming ES, 30 min
ideas.why: rotation into (out of) tech is a flow that persists through the session

ideas.name: flip1 with the MES box agreeing
ideas.why: a flip both index futures agree on is broad-market flow, not one stock

ideas.name: potM1 with MES already turned
ideas.why: if the S&P's box has already flipped the warned way, the NQ warning is the laggard catching up

ideas.name: flip1 one side of VWAP for an hour
ideas.why: a session that never crossed VWAP is a trend day; flips its way continue

ideas.name: potM1 at a double top or bottom
ideas.why: a second test of the session extreme that stalls has failed to find new buyers (sellers)

ideas.name: flip1 in the last hour
ideas.why: closing flows (rebalancing, MOC imbalances) push one way into the close
